info.name: Get the schema of a sequence

params.name: conflictMode
params.description:
conflict mode of the transformation.
 One of the following conflictMode types can be provided:
 `upsert`, `delete`

params.name: viewSpace
params.description: Space of the View. Not required if `isConnectionDefinition` is true. Relevant for View centric schema.

params.name: viewExternalId
params.description: External id of the View. Not required if `isConnectionDefinition` is true. Relevant for View centric schema.

params.name: viewVersion
params.description: Version of the View. Not required if `isConnectionDefinition` is true. Relevant for View centric schema.

params.name: withInstanceSpace
params.description: Is instance space set at the transformation config or not

params.name: isConnectionDefinition
params.description: If the edge is a connection definition or not

params.name: dataModelSpace
params.description: Space of the Data Model. Relevant for Data Model centric schema.

params.name: dataModelExternalId
params.description: External id of the Data Model. Relevant for Data Model centric schema.

params.name: dataModelVersion
params.description: Version of the Data Model. Relevant for Data Model centric schema.

params.name: type
params.description: External id of the View in the Data model. Relevant for Data Model centric schema.

params.name: relationshipFromType
params.description: Property Identifier of Connection Definition in `type`. Relevant for Data Model centric schema.

items.docs:
> **Required capabilities:** `transformationsAcl:READ`

For View centric schema, `viewSpace`, `viewExternalId`, `viewVersion` need to be specified while `withInstanceSpace`, `isConnectionDefinition`, `instanceType` are optional . For Data Model centric schema, `dataModelSpace`, `dataModelExternalId`, `dataModelVersion`, `type` need to be specified and `relationshipFromType` is optional. For Both scenarios `conflictMode` is required.

info.name: Get the schema of resource type

params.name: schemaType
params.description:
Name of the target schema type, please provide one of the following:
 `assets`, `timeseries`, `asset_hierarchy`, `events`, `datapoints`
 `string_datapoints`, `sequences`, `files`, `labels`,
 `relationships`, `raw`, `data_sets`

params.name: conflictMode
params.description:
One of the following conflictMode types can be provided:
 `abort`, `upsert`, `update`, `delete`
